results.rationale: The blue-and-cream carton, cap, cow graphic and white backdrop remain consistent with the source object. Rotation only modestly widens the cow panel: the MILK front and broad roof remain visible instead of the reference's straight side elevation and nearly hidden cap. This is a substantially incomplete viewpoint change, although the edited carton has clean geometry and readable graphics.

The two glass positions, grey setting and basic vessel shapes are preserved. Red beams enter from the left, but run largely above the liquid; extra vertical beams and dark suspended chunks are also added. This only partly depicts the requested soy-milk experiment and fails the explanation's beam through both liquids. The unexplained crossing laser paths and conspicuous chunky liquid make the scene visually unnatural.
